items.name: httpx
items.desc: Fast multi-purpose HTTP toolkit for probing hosts, URLs and CIDRs: titles, status codes, TLS certificates, HTTP2, virtual hosts, CSP, tech detection; Go; MIT.

items.name: subfinder
items.desc: Fast passive subdomain enumeration from curated sources with resolution and wildcard elimination; JSON/file/stdout outputs, stdin pipeline support; Go; MIT.

items.name: theHarvester
items.desc: Passive recon from public sources (search engines, cert data, DNS) collecting emails, subdomains and names; Python CLI, for authorized testing.

items.name: waybackurls
items.desc: Fetches every URL a domain ever responded to, from the Wayback Machine/CDX index; one domain in, raw URLs out; Go; license not stated.

items.name: Birdbrain
items.desc: OSINT evidence-capture desktop app and Chromium extension: MHTML, screenshot and text per case, SHA-256 hash chain, RFC 3161 timestamps, export; Windows/Ubuntu; MIT.

items.name: BuiltWith
items.desc: Identifies web technologies of a website: CMS, hosting, CDN, analytics, frameworks; free lookups, paid account and API.

items.name: Censys
items.desc: Search engine for internet hosts and certificates: deep scanning, API, attack surface analysis.

items.name: Company Researcher
items.desc: Company research tool: takes a company URL and returns website, LinkedIn, funding, news and competitor data via Exa search API; Next.js/TypeScript; MIT.

items.name: DNSDumpster
items.desc: Free passive recon tool from HackerTarget that maps a domain's internet-visible hosts through its DNS records, showing the attack surface for pentesters, bug bounty hunters and defenders. Membership and API available.

items.name: FOCA
items.desc: Windows tool to extract metadata and hidden info from public documents (PDF/Office); C#, GitHub; last updated Dec 2022.

items.name: FOFA
items.desc: Cyberspace search engine (the Chinese Shodan): searches for devices, services and DBs across the whole internet by fingerprints.

items.name: ICANN Lookup
items.desc: Official ICANN registration data lookup: WHOIS record, registrar and nameserver data for domains; free, no account.

items.name: Metadata2Go
items.desc: Online metadata extractor for photo, video, audio and documents: EXIF, IPTC and embedded fields via browser upload; free, no account.

items.name: Save Page WE
items.desc: Browser extension saving a full local copy of a web page with resources, scripts and links to one HTML file; Chrome/Firefox; maintained mirror, upstream last updated 2023.

items.name: SecurityTrails
items.desc: Domain and DNS intelligence: current and historical WHOIS, DNS records, subdomains and host search; free tier and API.

items.name: Shodan
items.desc: Search engine for internet-connected devices: cameras, servers, DBs, IoT — with filters by country/port/banner.

items.name: Social Searcher
items.desc: Instant social media search engine: posts, mentions and users by keyword across major networks; free searches, paid dashboard and API.

items.name: Sputnik
items.desc: Open-source OSINT browser extension: searches associated social accounts, domains, emails and on-site data from the browser menu; free.

items.name: ViewDNS
items.desc: DNS toolbox: reverse IP and reverse WHOIS, DNS history, record lookups, trace and port tools on one site; free web UI with API.

items.name: Web Archives
items.desc: Browser extension (Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari) that finds archived and cached versions of the current page across 20+ archive services; free.

items.name: Web Check
items.desc: Full website analysis in one click: technologies, risks, infrastructure

items.name: Whoxy
items.desc: WHOIS service: domain, historical and reverse WHOIS with cheap API and free web lookups.

items.name: ZoomEye
items.desc: Shodan-like search engine for internet-facing hosts, services and devices by IP, port and fingerprint; free with account, paid API.

items.name: FunStat
items.desc: Statistics and analytics for Telegram channels and chats

items.name: Telesint
items.desc: OSINT for Telegram: channels, users, activity

items.name: DeHashed
items.desc: Search engine over huge collections of leaks: email, nickname, phone, IP — shows what has been exposed in leaked databases.

items.name: GitGraber
items.desc: Real-time GitHub monitoring for leaks: credit cards, tokens, API keys — catches secrets in the live data stream.

items.name: HaveIBeenPwned
items.desc: whether an email has appeared in leaks

items.name: Intelligence X
items.desc: Search engine for leaks, data dumps and the dark web

items.name: LeakCheck
items.desc: Checking email/username/phone against leak databases

items.name: LeakIX
items.desc: Search engine for open services and leaks: finds unsecured DBs, admin panels and compromised hosts on the internet.

items.name: MailAccess
items.desc: OSINT email tool: checks 800+ sites for leaks/linked accounts, builds identity graph showing profiles likely belonging to same person.

items.name: TruffleHog
items.desc: tool for finding leaked API keys and passwords in code, repositories and cloud storage, which additionally checks whether the found secret is actually valid

items.name: OsintGram
items.desc: Dump of data from any Instagram account: followers, stories

items.name: TracGram
items.desc: Instagram profile analysis: audience, engagement

items.name: Yes Its Me
items.desc: Checking whether an email is registered on Instagram

items.name: Creepy
items.desc: Geolocating a person from social network and photo metadata

items.name: GeoIntel
items.desc: Photo geolocation via Gemini: you throw in a shot — the AI determines the place it was taken with coordinates and a confidence level. CLI + web front end.

items.name: geowifi
items.desc: OSINT tool that finds the physical location of a wifi router by its MAC address (BSSID) or network name (SSID), querying several public geolocation databases at once

items.name: Raven (GeoSpy)
items.desc: 404 Media (2026-10-12) on Graylark's Raven: AI identifies home from photo via Zillow/Airbnb data, now interior analysis. LAPD/Miami-Dade Sheriff reportedly bought access. Paywalled.

items.name: Sentinel Axonia
items.desc: a map of events and structures happening in the world

items.name: WiGLE
items.desc: Global Wi-Fi network database with GPS coordinates, searchable by BSSID/SSID; maps, export and API; free with account.

items.name: Yandex Maps
items.desc: Yandex web maps: satellite imagery, panoramas, business info and photos; used for location verification in research.

items.name: Ahmia
items.desc: Search engine for the Tor network, accessible from the regular internet: an index of onion sites without the Tor browser.

items.name: Blackbird
items.desc: This is a tool for "doxxing": you enter a username or email, and it checks them on 600+ sites to see where else such an account exists, plus makes an AI profile of the person from the traces found.

items.name: ClatScope
items.desc: A universal OSINT combine in Python: geolocation, DNS, WHOIS, phone, email, leaks and 70+ more functions in one tool. For investigators and pentesters.

items.name: Darkdump
items.desc: dark web search right from the terminal: several deepweb search engines with one command

items.name: Flowsint
items.desc: Graph OSINT platform: build connection graphs (domains, IPs, emails, phones, wallets, social); enrichers auto-fill WHOIS, subdomains, leaks, Maigret, crypto txs. Self-host Docker, Neo4j inside.

items.name: GHunt
items.desc: An offensive Google framework: pulls out info about Google accounts: email, photo, Google Maps reviews, service IDs, linked documents.

items.name: Hacking Tool
items.desc: A mega collection of hacking tools in one console

items.name: Hippie OSINT Toolkit
items.desc: a repository of tools and resources for OSINT research

items.name: IntelTrace
items.desc: OSINT doxxing tool: input email/phone/username, collects leaks/social/location from open sources, outputs risk-assessed report.

items.name: Maltego
items.desc: Graph-based OSINT: visualizing connections between people, domains, companies

items.name: Mimik
items.desc: An OSINT tool: collection and analysis of public data on a target, modular structure.

items.name: OSINT Framework
items.desc: Interactive map-reference of all OSINT tools

items.name: OSINT Stividor
items.desc: Autonomous OSINT system that builds a dossier from a chain of leads

items.name: Osiris
items.desc: an analog of the Palantir system

items.name: Seeker
items.desc: Precise geolocation of a target via a specially generated link

items.name: ShadowBroker
items.desc: OSINT framework for full profiling of a person from open sources

items.name: Spider Foot
items.desc: Any internet leads

items.name: TorBot
items.desc: This is a crawler (link collector) for sites on the dark web (the Tor network, .onion addresses): you give it a link, and it "crawls" the site, collects linked URLs and builds a clear tree of connections from them.

items.name: Torch
items.desc: Classic darknet search engine: an index of Tor onion sites, the simplest interface with nothing extra.

items.name: Uncover
items.desc: Search for exposed devices and services via Shodan, Censys, Fofa

items.name: Awesome OSINT
items.desc: General knowledge about OSINT and services

items.name: Awesome OSINT Arsenal
items.desc: This is a big list of 1100+ tools for OSINT (open-source intelligence)

items.name: Cyber Sources
items.desc: resources and tools for cybersecurity

items.name: Dorks Collections List
items.desc: Curated search dorks by platform/topic (Google, Shodan, Censys, GitHub, admin panels, SQLi, cloud, logs, CMS, bug bounty, LinkedIn X-ray) plus dork files for AWS, Azure, CCTV. No license.

items.name: OSINT Catalog
items.desc: Large catalog of OSINT tools with filters by category, type and access: search by people, dorks, ports, bots. Has a graph and legal reference.

items.name: OSINT Observer
items.desc: Interactive map of OSINT services by category

items.name: OSINT Stuff Tool Collection
items.desc: Cipher387's collection of several hundred online OSINT tools with a searchable categorized database (username, email, GEOINT and more); GPL-3.0; active.

items.name: trace My Clip
items.desc: Tool for reverse video search

items.name: Maigret
items.desc: Powerful OSINT by nickname: checks an account on 3000+ sites and pulls extra info from the profiles found. From the Sherlock maintainer.

items.name: Namechk
items.desc: Checks a username across hundreds of social networks and domain TLDs for availability and existing profiles; free web tool.

items.name: Sherlock
items.desc: searches social networks by username

items.name: Social Analyzer
items.desc: Profiling a person by usernames across 100+ social networks

items.name: Tookie OSINT
items.desc: you enter a username (nickname), and the tool checks a bunch of sites and finds all accounts with that name, an analog of the well-known Sherlock.

items.name: Userrecon
items.desc: a simple script that checks the same nickname on 75+ sites at once; the repository is now abandoned (archived, no longer updated).

items.name: UserSearch
items.desc: Reverse user lookup: profiles by username, email, phone or photo across social and dating sites; limited free search, paid accounts.

items.name: WhatsMyName
items.desc: Username lookup across 700+ websites powered by the open WhatsMyName dataset, web UI of the community project; free, no account.

items.name: PimEyes
items.desc: Search for a person by photo across photos from the whole internet

items.name: RevEye
items.desc: Reverse image search extension for Chrome: sends the image or URL to Google, Bing, Yandex and TinEye from the context menu; free.

items.name: Search by Image
items.desc: Reverse image search extension (Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari): right-click or capture part of a page to query several engines; free.

items.name: TinEye
items.desc: Reverse image search: find the source and copies of an image

items.name: GhostTrack
items.desc: OSINT by number: carrier, geo, linked accounts

items.name: PhoneDox
items.desc: Doxing by phone number via open sources

items.name: PhoneInfoga
items.desc: Open-source Go phone OSINT: country, carrier, line type; scanners query APIs, directories, search engines (VoIP, reputation, social). Web UI, REST API, Docker. GPL-3.0. Unmaintained; no tracking.

items.name: PhoneNumber-OSINT
items.desc: An OSINT tool for gathering information by phone number: carrier, region, leaks and linked accounts.

items.name: Search Phone
items.desc: A simple terminal script: you enter a phone number, and through a third-party service (RapidAPI) it returns all the available information about it (carrier, region, etc.).

items.name: Email Hunter
items.desc: OSINT email reconnaissance: finds password leaks, social profiles, domains, GitHub; gives compromise risk assessment.

items.name: EmailRep
items.desc: Email reputation scoring API: spam, breach and social/professional presence indicators per address; free queries, paid higher rates.

items.name: holehe
items.desc: where an email is used

items.name: Hunter.io
items.desc: Finds and verifies professional email addresses for a domain: domain search, patterns, verifier; free tier and API.

items.name: Mail Tester
items.desc: Deliverability check: get a test address, send a message, view spam score plus SPF/DKIM/DMARC analysis; free, no account.

items.name: Mailcat
items.desc: Python CLI that finds existing email addresses by nickname across mail providers via API and SMTP probes; no notification mails; Apache-2.0.

items.name: SignalHire
items.desc: Contact finder: verified emails and phone numbers for professionals by name, company or LinkedIn URL; small free tier, paid credits.

items.name: Skymem
items.desc: Searches email addresses of companies and people by domain or company name; web UI, limited free results.

items.name: user-scanner
items.desc: OSINT tool that checks registration on 285+ sites by email or username
